lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The stock went into the print up 19.5% in 20 sessions and 21% in 60, to a record of about SEK 118. The October leg tracks Swedish government-formation news that lowered the odds of a free-school profit ban (the Centre Party refuses a ban and is needed for an S-led government; on 2026-10-26 its centrist-government attempt failed), not earnings news. This is the setup in which last year's Q1 (after +56% YTD) was sold 6.1% on a miss.

findings.finding: Swedish government formation is unresolved inside the window. The stock has moved 4-15% in a day on profit-ban politics (+5% intraday and -4% back on 2026-09-14 on one Dagens ETC report). Any step that falls between 30 Oct and 2 Nov can swamp the print, with unknown sign.

findings.finding: Takeda, the closest listed plasma peer, reported on Oct 29 (after Grifols' last release) that IVIG revenue declined in H1 FY26 'as a result of the phasing as well as market and price dynamics', warned of a 'supply-demand dynamic change emerging' in immunoglobulin, and cut its albumin forecast on 'stronger-than-expected cost containment measures in China'. That is a negative read for Grifols' Q3 IVIG pricing and for its plan for H2 albumin to match H2-25 in absolute terms.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: IG is Grifols' growth engine: H1-26 IG +12.8% cc with albumin -14.2% cc, and the stock rose +3.67% on that release. When albumin was weak in Q1-26 the stock fell -2.36% (my calculation from Yahoo closes, release 2026-05-07).

findings.finding: The FY26 guide needs a steep H2. Adj EBITDA margin must go from 23.9% in H1 to >=25% for the year (about 26% in H2), and FCF pre-M&A from EUR91m in H1 to EUR500-575m (EUR409-484m in H2). Renta 4's own model already sits below the margin guide at 24.8%, and the consensus Q3 bar asks for 26.4% margin and EUR202m FCF. So the Q3 release decides whether the guide holds, and the downside tail (a trim) is larger than the upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide reiterated with an in-line quarter: H1-26 +3.67%. Guide reiterated but the quarter called 'algo débiles' against consensus: Q1-26 -2.36%. FY25 (new-year guide) -3.97%. The new 2029 plan in Feb 2025 +14.32%. All my calculations from Yahoo closes on the issuer's release dates.

findings.finding: Grifols paused plasma collection at all its Canadian centres on Aug 14 after a Health Canada non-compliance notice, and the pause covered 48 days of Q3. Per Benzinga ES only two of 17 centres had resumed by Oct 20, and Grifols has not quantified the cost. The idle centre cost lands in Q3 COGS or adjustments, and lost liters raise future cost per liter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The closest precedent is the US centre closures (29 centres, Apr 2026). Grifols booked the cost in adjustments (Q2 adj EBITDA carried EUR39m of adjustments, the closures the main one) and the stock rose +3.67% on that print, so the market looked through a centre one-off once already.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Into Q3-25 the stock was near highs and fell -3.24% on the print. Into H1-26 it was depressed and rose +3.67%. Both my calculations from Yahoo closes.
